title.zh: 卷二十一 志第一: 禮儀一
title.raw: 卷二十一 志第一: 禮儀一 Volume 21 Treatises 1: Rites 1

sentences.zh: 唐禮：四時各以孟月享太廟，每室用太牢，季冬蠟祭之後，以辰日臘享於太廟，用牲如時祭。

translations.literal: Tang rites: In each of the four seasons, in the first month of the season, offerings were made to the Great Ancestral Temple; for each chamber the great offering was used. After the wax sacrifices following the twelfth month's la rites, on a chen day a la offering was presented at the Great Temple, with victims as at the seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Tang ritual: each season's first month, offerings at the Great Temple—tai lao per chamber. After twelfth-month wax and la, a chen-day la feast at the temple used seasonal victims.

sentences.zh: 三年一祫，以孟冬。

translations.literal: Every three years a he sacrifice, in the first month of winter.
translations.idiomatic: A he rite every three years, in mid-winter's opening month.

sentences.zh: 五年一禘，以孟夏。

translations.literal: Every five years a di sacrifice, in the first month of summer.
translations.idiomatic: A di rite every five years, in mid-summer's opening month.

sentences.zh: 又時享之日，修七祀於太廟西門內之道南：司命，戶以春，灶以夏；

translations.literal: On days of seasonal offerings, the Seven Sacrifices were maintained on the road south within the western gate of the Great Temple: Spirit of Fate; the Household Spirit in spring, the Stove Spirit in summer;
translations.idiomatic: On seasonal offering days the Seven Sacrifices were kept on the lane south of the temple's west gate—Spirit of Fate; Household Spirit in spring, Stove Spirit in summer;

sentences.zh: 門，厲以秋，行以冬，中溜則于季夏迎氣日祀之。

translations.literal: the Gate Spirit and the Pestilence Spirit in autumn, the Road Spirit in winter; the Central Gutter was sacrificed on the day of receiving seasonal qi in the last month of summer.
translations.idiomatic: Gate and Pestilence Spirits in autumn, Road Spirit in winter; Central Gutter on the last-summer qi-reception day.

sentences.zh: 若品物時新堪進御者，所司先送太常，與尚食相知，簡擇精好者，以滋味與新物相宜者配之。

translations.literal: If seasonal novelties were fit to present to the sovereign, the responsible office first sent them to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and coordinated with the Imperial Provisioners, selecting the finest and pairing them with flavors suited to the new goods.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal delicacies fit for the throne went first to the Court of Sacrifices and the Provisioners, who picked the best and matched flavor to the new offering.

sentences.zh: 太常卿奉薦於太廟，不出神主。

translations.literal: The Minister of Imperial Sacrifices presented offerings at the Great Temple without bringing out the spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Sacrifices presented at the Great Temple without removing the tablets.

sentences.zh: 仲春薦冰，亦如之。

translations.literal: In mid-spring ice was presented—in the same manner.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-spring ice offerings followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 武德元年五月，備法駕迎宣簡公，懿王、景皇帝、元皇帝神主，祔於太廟，始享四室。

translations.literal: In Wude 1, fifth month, the full ceremonial carriage was prepared to welcome the spirit tablets of Duke Xuanjian, King Yi, Emperor Jing, and Emperor Yuan; they were enshrined in the Grand Temple, and offerings first began in four chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude 1, fifth month, full ceremonial escort welcomed the tablets of Duke Xuanjian, King Yi, Emperor Jing, and Emperor Yuan into the Grand Temple; offerings then began in four chambers.

sentences.zh: 貞觀九年，高祖崩，將行遷祔之禮，太宗命有司詳議廟制。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan 9, Gaozu died. When the rite of removal and enshrinement was about to be performed, Taizong ordered the offices to deliberate in detail on the temple system.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan 9, after Gaozu died and removal-enshrinement rites were due, Taizong ordered the offices to review the temple system in detail.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫朱子奢建議曰：按漢丞相韋玄成奏立五廟，諸侯亦同五。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Grandee Zhu Zishe proposed: According to Han Chancellor Wei Xuancheng's memorial, five temples were to be established, and the regional lords likewise had five.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Grandee Zhu Zishe proposed that Han Chancellor Wei Xuancheng had memorialized for five temples, with regional lords also having five.

sentences.zh: 劉子駿議開七祖，邦君降二。

translations.literal: Liu Zijun proposed opening seven ancestors, with lords of states reduced by two.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zijun argued for seven ancestral temples, with state lords reduced by two.

sentences.zh: 鄭司農踵玄成之轍，王子雍揚國師之波，分塗並驅，各相師祖，鹹玩共所習，好同惡異。

translations.literal: Zheng Sinong followed in Xuancheng's tracks, and Wang Ziyong raised the wave of the state teacher; they drove along separate roads, each taking his own master and ancestor, all playing with what they were accustomed to, liking sameness and disliking difference.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Sinong followed Xuancheng, while Wang Ziyong promoted the other school; each side followed its own teachers, clinging to habit and favoring what matched its learning.

sentences.zh: 遂令歷代祧祀，多少參差，優劣去取，曾無畫一。

translations.literal: They therefore caused the removal sacrifices of successive ages to vary in number, with choices between better and worse never made uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Thus temple removals across the dynasties varied in number and judgment, never reaching a single standard.

sentences.zh: 《傳》稱「名位不同，禮亦異數。」

translations.literal: 《Tradition》 says, "When names and positions differ, rites also have different numbers."
translations.idiomatic: 《Tradition》 says, "When names and ranks differ, ritual numbers differ as well."

sentences.zh: 《易》云「卑高以陳，貴賤位矣」。

translations.literal: 《Changes》 says, "Low and high are arrayed, and noble and base take their positions."
translations.idiomatic: 《Changes》 says, "Low and high are arrayed, and noble and base take their places."

sentences.zh: 豈非別嫌疑，慎微遠，防陵僭，尊君卑佐，陞降無舛，所貴禮者，義在茲乎！

translations.literal: Is this not to distinguish doubts, be careful about subtle remoteness, guard against overstepping and usurpation, honor the ruler and humble the assistants, and keep ascent and descent without error? The meaning for which ritual is valued lies here!
translations.idiomatic: This distinguishes doubtful ranks, guards against overstepping, honors the ruler and lowers the assistants, and keeps ascent and descent correct; this is precisely why ritual matters!

sentences.zh: 若使天子諸侯，俱立五廟，便是賤可以同貴，臣可以濫主，名器無准，冠屨同歸，禮亦異數，義將安設？

translations.literal: If the Son of Heaven and the regional lords both establish five temples, then the base may be the same as the noble, ministers may trespass on the ruler, names and vessels have no standard, cap and shoe return to the same place; if rites also have different numbers, where will the meaning be set?
translations.idiomatic: If emperor and lords both had five temples, low would equal high and ministers would intrude on the ruler; names and ranks would lose all standard. Where then could ritual meaning stand?

sentences.zh: 《戴記》又稱：「禮有以多為貴者，天子七廟，諸侯五廟。」

translations.literal: 《Dai Records》 also says: "In ritual there are cases where greater number marks honor: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, and the regional lords have five."
translations.idiomatic: 《Dai Records》 also says, "Some rites honor greater number: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, the regional lords five."

sentences.zh: 若天子五廟，才與子男相埒，以多為貴，何所表乎？

translations.literal: If the Son of Heaven had five temples, he would merely be equal to viscounts and barons; when greater number marks honor, what would be displayed?
translations.idiomatic: If the emperor had only five temples, he would equal viscounts and barons; if number marks honor, what would that show?

sentences.zh: 愚以為諸侯立高祖以下，並太祖五廟，一國之貴也。

translations.literal: I foolishly think that regional lords establish temples from the great-great-grandfather downward, together with the Grand Ancestor, making five temples; this is the honor of one state.
translations.idiomatic: In my view, a regional lord has five temples: from the great-great-grandfather downward, plus the Grand Ancestor, matching the honor of one state.

sentences.zh: 天子立高祖以上，並太祖七廟，四海之尊也。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven establishes temples above the great-great-grandfather, together with the Grand Ancestor, making seven temples; this is the honor of all within the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven has seven temples, extending above the great-great-grandfather and including the Grand Ancestor, matching the honor of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 降殺以兩，禮之正焉。

translations.literal: Reduction by two is the correctness of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Reducing by two marks the proper ritual distinction.

sentences.zh: 前史所謂「德厚者流光，德薄者流卑」，此其義也。

translations.literal: What earlier histories call "those of thick virtue flow with brilliance; those of thin virtue flow basely" has this meaning.
translations.idiomatic: This is what earlier histories mean by, "Deep virtue flows in brightness; thin virtue flows downward."

sentences.zh: 伏惟聖祖在天，山陵有日，祔祖嚴配，大事在斯。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that the Sagely Ancestor is in Heaven, the day of the mausoleum is set, and solemnly enshrining and pairing the ancestor is a great affair that lies here.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Sagely Ancestor is in Heaven and the mausoleum date is set; solemn enshrinement is the great matter before us.

sentences.zh: 宜依七廟，用崇大禮。

translations.literal: It is proper to follow the seven temples and thereby exalt the great rite.
translations.idiomatic: The seven-temple system should be followed to honor the great rite.

sentences.zh: 若親盡之外，有王業之所基者，如殷之玄王，周之后稷，尊為始祖。

translations.literal: If beyond exhausted kinship there is one on whom the royal enterprise was founded, like Xuan Wang of Yin or Hou Ji of Zhou, he is honored as founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When beyond the exhausted kinship line there is someone on whom royal rule was founded, such as Xuan Wang of Yin or Hou Ji of Zhou, he is honored as founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 倘無其例，請三昭三穆，各置神主，太祖一室，考而虛位。

translations.literal: If there is no such precedent, I request that the three zhao and three mu each have spirit tablets, with one chamber for the Grand Ancestor, and that the father's place be examined and left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no such founder, then set tablets for the three zhao and three mu, reserve one Grand Ancestor chamber, and leave the father's position vacant after examination.

sentences.zh: 將待七百之祚，遞遷方處，庶上依晉、宋，傍愜人情。

translations.literal: Then wait for a fortune of seven hundred years, and only after successive removals will placement be made; perhaps above it will follow Jin and Song, and alongside it will satisfy human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Only after the dynasty has lasted through successive removals should the positions settle; this would follow Jin and Song precedent and satisfy human sentiment.

sentences.zh: 於是八座奏曰：臣聞揖讓受終之後，革命創制之君，何嘗不崇親親之義，篤尊尊之道，虔奉祖宗，致敬郊廟。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Eight Ministers memorialized: We have heard that after yielding and receiving completion, rulers who changed the mandate and created institutions have always exalted the meaning of kinship with kin, deepened the way of honoring the honored, reverently served ancestors, and brought respect to suburban and temple rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Ministers then memorialized: since antiquity, founders who received the mandate and created new institutions have honored kinship, respected the honored, served the ancestors reverently, and shown respect in suburban and temple rites.

sentences.zh: 自義乖闕里，學滅秦庭，儒雅既喪，經籍湮殄。

translations.literal: Since righteousness went astray from Que Village and learning was destroyed at the Qin court, refined Confucian learning was lost and the classics were submerged and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: After Confucian learning was disrupted and Qin destroyed the schools, refined scholarship was lost and the classics were buried.

sentences.zh: 雖兩漢纂修絕業，魏、晉敦尚斯文，而宗廟制度，典章散逸，習所傳而競偏說，執淺見而起異端。

translations.literal: Although the two Han compiled and repaired the severed enterprise, and Wei and Jin honored this culture, ancestral-temple institutions and regulations were scattered and lost; people practiced what had been transmitted and competed in partial theories, clinging to shallow views and raising heterodox claims.
translations.idiomatic: Although Han restored broken learning and Wei and Jin honored the classics, temple institutions and regulations had scattered; scholars clung to inherited partial theories and produced divergent claims.

sentences.zh: 自昔迄茲，多歷年代，語其大略，兩家而已。

translations.literal: From antiquity to now, through many ages, speaking of the broad outline, there have been only two schools.
translations.idiomatic: Across the ages, the debate in broad terms has had only two schools.

sentences.zh: 祖鄭玄者則陳四廟之制，述王肅者則引七廟之文，貴賤混而莫辯，是非紛而不定。

translations.literal: Those who take Zheng Xuan as ancestor present the four-temple system; those who transmit Wang Su cite the seven-temple text. Noble and base are mixed and not distinguished; right and wrong are tangled and not settled.
translations.idiomatic: Followers of Zheng Xuan set out the four-temple system, while followers of Wang Su cite the seven-temple texts; rank becomes confused and the right answer remains unsettled.

sentences.zh: 陛下至德自然，孝思罔極，孺慕逾匹夫之志，製作窮聖人之道，誠宜定一代之宏規，為萬世之彝則。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's utmost virtue is natural, and your filial thought has no limit; your childlike longing exceeds an ordinary man's intent, and your institutions exhaust the Way of the sages. Truly you should establish the grand rule of one age and make the constant model for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's virtue and filial feeling are boundless, and your institutions reach the sages' Way; you should set the grand rule for this age and the enduring model for all later generations.

sentences.zh: 臣奉述睿旨，討論往載，紀七廟者實多，稱四祖者蓋寡。

translations.literal: We respectfully state the sagely intent and examine past records: those recording seven temples are truly many, and those speaking of four ancestors are few.
translations.idiomatic: Examining past records in light of Your Majesty's intent, we find many references to seven temples and few to four ancestors.

sentences.zh: 校其得失，昭然可見。

translations.literal: Comparing their gains and losses, it can be seen clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Their merits and faults are plain.

sentences.zh: 《春秋谷梁傳》及《禮記》、《王制》、《祭法》、《禮器》《孔子家語》，並云：「天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟，士二廟。」

translations.literal: 《Chunqiu Guliang zhuan》, 《Liji》, 《Wang System》, 《Sacrificial Regulations》, 《Ritual Vessels》, and 《Kongzi jiayu》 all say: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples, regional lords five temples, great officers three temples, and knights two temples."
translations.idiomatic: 《Chunqiu Guliang zhuan》, 《Liji》, 《Wang System》, 《Sacrificial Regulations》, 《Ritual Vessels》, and 《Kongzi jiayu》 all say: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples; regional lords, five; great officers, three; and knights, two."

sentences.zh: 《尚書》曰：「七世之廟，可以觀德。」

translations.literal: 《Documents》 says: "Through seven generations of temples one may observe virtue."
translations.idiomatic: 《Documents》 says: "Through seven generations of temples, one may observe virtue."

sentences.zh: 至於孫卿、孔安國、劉歆、班彪父子、孔晁、虞喜、幹寶之徒，或學推碩儒，或才稱博物，商較今古，鹹以為然。

translations.literal: As for Sun Qing, Kong Anguo, Liu Xin, Ban Biao and son, Kong Chao, Yu Xi, Gan Bao, and their sort, some were learned and esteemed as great Confucians, others were talented and known for broad knowledge; comparing past and present, all considered it so.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Qing, Kong Anguo, Liu Xin, Ban Biao and his son, Kong Chao, Yu Xi, Gan Bao, and others were either eminent classicists or broadly learned men, and all agreed after comparing ancient and later practice.

sentences.zh: 故其文曰：「天子三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七。」

translations.literal: Thus the text says: "The Son of Heaven has three zhao and three mu, together with the Grand Ancestor's temple, making seven."
translations.idiomatic: Thus the text says: "The Son of Heaven has three zhao and three mu, plus the Grand Ancestor's temple, making seven."

sentences.zh: 晉、宋、齊、梁，皆依斯義，立親廟六，豈非有國之茂典，不刊之休烈乎？

translations.literal: Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang all followed this meaning and established six kin temples. Is this not the flourishing canon of states and an excellent achievement not to be cut away?
translations.idiomatic: Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang all followed this principle and established six kin temples. Was this not a splendid state canon and lasting achievement?

sentences.zh: 若使違群經之明文，從累代之疑議，背子雍之篤論，尊康成之舊學，則天子之禮，下逼於人臣，諸侯之制，上僭于王者，非所謂尊卑有序，名位不同者也。

translations.literal: If one violates the clear texts of the many classics, follows the doubtful debates of successive generations, turns against Ziyong's firm argument, and honors Kangcheng's old learning, then the rites of the Son of Heaven are pressed downward toward ministers, and the system of regional lords usurps upward toward the king; this is not what is meant by noble and base having order and names and positions being different.
translations.idiomatic: To reject the clear classics, follow generations of doubtful debate, abandon Ziyong, and honor Zheng Kangcheng's old theory would lower the emperor's rites toward those of ministers and let regional lords usurp royal form. That is not ordered hierarchy or distinct rank.

sentences.zh: 況復禮由人情，自非天墜，大孝莫重於尊親，厚本莫先于嚴配。

translations.literal: Moreover, ritual comes from human feeling and does not fall from Heaven. In great filial piety nothing is more important than honoring kin, and in thickening the root nothing comes before solemn enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual arises from human feeling, not from Heaven alone. In filial piety nothing is greater than honoring kin, and in strengthening the root nothing comes before solemn enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 數盡四廟，非貴多之道；

translations.literal: For the number to end at four temples is not the way of valuing greater number;
translations.idiomatic: Stopping at four temples is not the way to honor greater number;

sentences.zh: 祀逮七世，得加隆之心。

translations.literal: for sacrifices to reach seven generations obtains the heart of added exaltation.
translations.idiomatic: extending sacrifice to seven generations expresses the wish to magnify honor.

sentences.zh: 是知德厚者流光，乃可久之高義；

translations.literal: Thus one knows that "those of thick virtue flow with brilliance" is a high meaning that can endure;
translations.idiomatic: Thus "deep virtue flows in brightness" is an enduring high principle;

sentences.zh: 德薄者流卑，實不易之令範。

translations.literal: and "those of thin virtue flow basely" is truly an excellent model that cannot be changed.
translations.idiomatic: and "thin virtue flows downward" is an unchanging model.

sentences.zh: 臣等參議，請依晉、宋故事，立親廟六，其祖宗之制，式遵舊典。

translations.literal: We have deliberated and request following the precedents of Jin and Song: establish six kin temples, and in the system of ancestors and zong, reverently follow the old canons.
translations.idiomatic: After deliberation, we request following Jin and Song precedent by establishing six kin temples and keeping the old canon for ancestors and zong.

sentences.zh: 庶承宗之道，興於理定之辰；

translations.literal: Perhaps the way of continuing the ancestral line will arise at the moment when principle is settled;
translations.idiomatic: Then the way of continuing the ancestral line may flourish when principle is settled;

sentences.zh: 尊祖之義，成於孝治之日。

translations.literal: and the meaning of honoring ancestors will be completed on the day of filial governance.
translations.idiomatic: and the meaning of honoring ancestors will be fulfilled in an age of filial rule.

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: The decree followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 於是增修太廟，始崇祔弘農府君及高祖神主，並舊四室為六室。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Great Temple was enlarged and renovated; for the first time the spirit tablets of the Lord of Hongnong and Gaozu were elevated to enshrinement, together with the former four chambers making six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Temple was expanded; Hongnong Lord and Gaozu were first elevated to enshrinement, bringing the shrine to six chambers.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，太宗崩，將行崇祔之禮，禮部尚書許敬宗奏言：「弘農府君廟應迭毀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Taizong died; they were about to perform the elevated-enshrinement rite. Minister of Rites Xu Jingzong memorialized, saying: "The temple of the Lord of Hongnong should be destroyed in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Year 23: Taizong died; elevated enshrinement was due. Xu Jingzong of Rites wrote: "The Hongnong Lord's temple should rotate out.

sentences.zh: 謹按舊儀，漢丞相韋玄成以為毀主瘞埋。

translations.literal: According to former rites, Han Chancellor-in-ordinary Wei Xuancheng held that destroyed spirit tablets should be buried in the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Former rites: Han Chancellor Wei Xuancheng said destroyed tablets should be buried.

sentences.zh: 但萬國宗饗，有所從來，一旦瘞埋，事不允愜。

translations.literal: Yet when the myriad states pay collective honor, there is an origin for ritual—suddenly to bury them would not be acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet all realms honor a lineage with roots—sudden burial would not satisfy.

sentences.zh: 晉博士范宣意欲別立廟宇，奉征西等主安置其中。

translations.literal: Jin Erudite Fan Xuan wished to establish a separate temple and place therein the spirit tablets of the Commander who Pacified the West and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Jin scholar Fan Xuan wanted a separate shrine for the Pacified-West commander and others.

sentences.zh: 方之瘞埋，頗葉情理，事無典故，亦未足依。

translations.literal: Compared with burial, this rather accords with reason, but there is no precedent and it is not sufficient to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: That beats burial in reason, but lacks precedent and cannot be followed.

sentences.zh: 又議者或言毀主藏於天府，祥瑞所藏，本非斯意。

translations.literal: Some debaters also said to store destroyed tablets in the Celestial Repository—the repository where auspicious objects were stored was not originally for this purpose.
translations.idiomatic: Others urged storing tablets in the Celestial Repository—but that treasury held omens, not ancestors.

sentences.zh: 今謹准量，去祧之外，猶有壇墠，祈禱所及，竊謂合宜。

translations.literal: We now carefully measure: beyond the distant ancestors, altars and open platforms for prayer still remain—a private opinion that this is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: We weigh the case: beyond the remote ancestors, prayer altars still stand—we deem that fitting.

sentences.zh: 今時廟制，與古不同，共基別室，西方為首。

translations.literal: The present temple system differs from antiquity: a shared foundation with separate chambers, the west taken as foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Today's temples differ from antiquity—one foundation, separate chambers, west ranked first.

sentences.zh: 若在西夾之中，仍處尊位，祈禱則祭，未絕祗享，方諸舊儀，情實可安。

translations.literal: If within the western side chambers they still occupy the honored position, and prayer sacrifices are offered without ending reverent offerings, compared with former rites, sentiment and fact can both be settled.
translations.idiomatic: If western side chambers keep honored rank and prayer offerings continue, old rite and present need both align.

sentences.zh: 弘農府君廟遠親殺，詳據舊章，禮合迭毀。

translations.literal: The Hongnong lord's temple is subject to reduced mourning for distant kin; per detailed examination of old regulations, ritual requires rotational destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Hongnong Lord is a distant relation—old statutes require his temple to rotate out.

sentences.zh: 臣等參議，遷奉神主，藏於夾室，本情篤教，在理為弘。」

translations.literal: Your subjects jointly deliberated: moving and enshrining the spirit tablets, storing them in the side chambers—in native feeling, profound teaching; in principle, expansive.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects jointly deliberated: moving and enshrining the spirit tablets, storing them in the side chambers—in native feeling, profound teaching; in principle, expansive."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 其年八月庚子，太宗文皇帝神主祔於太廟。

translations.literal: That year, eighth month, gengzi day, the spirit tablet of Emperor Wen Taizong was enshrined in the Great Temple.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eighth month, day gengzi: Taizong's tablet entered the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 文明元年八月，奉高宗神主祔於太廟中，始遷宣皇帝神主于夾室。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Wenming, Gaozong's spirit tablet was enshrined within the Grand Temple; for the first time, Emperor Xuan's spirit tablet was moved to the side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Wenming 1, eighth month: Gaozong's tablet was enshrined in the Grand Temple, and Xuan's tablet was moved to the side chamber for the first time.

sentences.zh: 垂拱四年正月，又於東都立高祖、太宗、高宗三廟，四時享祀，如京廟之儀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Chuigong, three temples for Gaozu, Taizong, and Gaozong were also established in the eastern capital; the four seasonal offerings followed the rites of the capital temples.
translations.idiomatic: Chuigong 4, first month: the eastern capital gained temples to Gaozu, Taizong, and Gaozong, with seasonal rites matching the capital.

sentences.zh: 別立崇先廟以享武氏祖考。

translations.literal: A separate Chongxian Temple was established to offer to the Wu clan ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: A separate Chongxian Temple was built for Wu clan ancestors.

sentences.zh: 則天尋又令所司議立崇先廟室數，司禮博士、崇文館學士周忭希旨，請立崇先廟為七室，其皇室太廟，減為五室。

translations.literal: Empress Zetian soon again ordered the offices to deliberate on how many chambers the Chongxian Temple should have; Court of Spring Rites erudite and Scholar of the Chongwen Institute Zhou Ping, to please her intent, requested seven chambers for Chongxian Temple and reduction of the imperial ancestral temple to five chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian soon ordered debate on Chongxian's chamber count; Zhou Ping of Spring Rites, courting her wish, urged seven chambers for Chongxian and five for the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 春官侍郎賈大隱奏曰：「臣竊准秦、漢皇太后臨朝稱制，並據禮經正文，天子七廟，諸侯五廟。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of the Court of Spring Rites Jia Dayin memorialized, saying: "Your subject ventures to cite Qin and Han, when empress dowagers held court and exercised regulatory power—all followed the canonical ritual texts: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Dayin of Spring Rites wrote: "Qin and Han dowagers who ruled from court all cited canon—the Son of Heaven keeps seven temples, lords five.

sentences.zh: 蓋百王不易之義，萬代常行之法，未有越禮違古而擅裁儀注者也。

translations.literal: This is the unchanging meaning of the hundred kings, the constant law of myriad generations—never has anyone transgressed ritual and antiquity to arrogate regulation of ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: That is the immovable rule of kings and ages—none has broken ritual to rewrite ceremony at will.

sentences.zh: 今周悰別引浮議，廣述異文，直崇臨朝權儀，不依國家常度，升崇先之廟而七，降國家之廟而五。

translations.literal: Now Zhou Cong cites floating opinions and broadly sets forth heterodox texts, directly elevating provisional rites of holding court, not relying on the state's constant norms—raising Chongxian temple to seven while lowering the state temple to five.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Cong now cites loose opinion and stray texts, exalting a regent's provisional rite over state norm—seven for Chongxian, five for the realm.

sentences.zh: 臣聞皇圖廣辟，實崇宗社之尊；

translations.literal: Your subject has heard: when the imperial design is broadly opened, it truly honors the altars of state;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard: when the throne's design is wide, the altars of state gain honor;

sentences.zh: 帝業弘基，實等山河之固。

translations.literal: when the imperial enterprise has a vast foundation, it truly equals the solidity of mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: when its foundation is vast, it matches mountains and rivers in firmness.

sentences.zh: 伏以天步多艱，時逢遏密，代天理物，自古有之。

translations.literal: Your subject observes: the heavenly steps have been many times arduous; times encountered mourning seclusion; one who substitutes for Heaven and governs things has existed since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's course has been hard; times of mourning seclusion came; regents who govern for Heaven are ancient.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇太后親承顧托，憂勤黎庶，納孝慈之請，垂矜撫之懷，實所謂光顯大猷，恢崇聖載。

translations.literal: Your subject respectfully considers: the Empress Dowager personally received the entrustment, labored in care for the common people, accepted the request of filial piety and compassion, extended a cherishing and soothing heart—this truly is what is called to glorify the great plan and expand the sage burden.
translations.idiomatic: The Dowager took the trust, toiled for the people, heard pleas of filial mercy, and soothed the realm—truly glorifying the great design and widening the sage charge.

sentences.zh: 其崇先廟室，合同諸侯之數，國家宗廟，不合輒有移變。

translations.literal: Chambers of Chongxian Temple should accord with the feudal lord count; the state ancestral temple must not casually be shifted.
translations.idiomatic: Chongxian should match a lord's count; the state temple must not be casually altered.

sentences.zh: 臣之愚直，並依正禮，周忭之請，實乖古儀。」

translations.literal: Your subject's stubborn directness wholly follows orthodox ritual; Zhou Ping's request truly contravenes ancient ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject's stubborn directness wholly follows orthodox ritual; Zhou Ping's request truly contravenes ancient ceremony."

sentences.zh: 則天由是且止，

translations.literal: Zetian therefore stopped for the time being,
translations.idiomatic: Zetian held off for the moment.

sentences.zh: 天授二年，則天既革命稱帝，於東都改制太廟為七廟室，奉武氏七代神主，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshou, after Zetian had changed the mandate and claimed the imperial title, she restructured the Grand Temple in the eastern capital into seven temple chambers, received the spirit tablets of seven generations of the Wu clan, and enshrined them in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshou 2: after Zetian's revolution and enthronement, the eastern-capital Grand Temple became seven chambers, where seven generations of Wu tablets were enshrined.

sentences.zh: 改西京太廟為享德廟，四時唯享高祖已下三室，餘四室令所司閉其門，廢其享祀之禮。

translations.literal: The western capital Great Temple was changed to the Virtue-Enjoying Temple; in the four seasons only the three chambers from Gaozu downward were offered; the remaining four chambers had their doors closed by order and their offering rites abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Western capital's Great Temple became Virtue-Enjoying Temple—only three chambers from Gaozu down were offered; four chambers were closed and their rites ended.

sentences.zh: 又改西京崇先廟為崇尊廟，其享祀如太廟之儀。

translations.literal: Also the western capital Chongxian Temple was changed to Chongzun Temple; its offerings followed the Great Temple rite.
translations.idiomatic: Western Chongxian became Chongzun Temple, with rites like the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 萬歲登封元年臘月，封嵩山回，親謁太廟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Wansui Dengfeng, returning from conferring feng on Mount Song, she personally visited the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Wansui Dengfeng 1, twelfth month: returning from the feng rite on Mount Song, she personally visited the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 明年七月，又改京崇尊廟，為太廟，仍改太廟署為清廟臺，加官員，崇其班秩。

translations.literal: Seventh month next year: also changed the capital Chongzun Temple back to Great Temple; still changed the Great Temple Bureau to Qingmiao Terrace, added staff, and elevated their rank.
translations.idiomatic: Next year, seventh month: Chongzun was restored as Great Temple; the temple office became Qingmiao Terrace with added staff and higher rank.

sentences.zh: 聖曆二年四月，又親祀太廟，曲赦東都城內。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Shengli, she again personally sacrificed at the Grand Temple and granted a special amnesty within the eastern capital walls.
translations.idiomatic: Shengli 2, fourth month: she sacrificed at the Grand Temple again and granted amnesty within the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 中宗即位，神龍元年正月，改享德廟依舊為京太廟。

translations.literal: After Zhongzong took the throne, in the first month of the first year of Shenlong, Xiangde Temple was changed back into the capital Grand Temple as before.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhongzong's accession, Shenlong 1, first month restored Xiangde Temple as the capital Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 五月，遷武氏七廟神主於西京之崇尊廟，東都創置太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month: moved the seven Wu clan temple spirit tablets to western capital Chongzun Temple; newly established Great Temple at eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: seven Wu tablets went to western Chongzun; a new Great Temple rose at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 太常博士張齊賢建議曰：昔孫卿子云：「有天下者事七代，有一國者事五代。」

translations.literal: Grand Ritual Erudite Zhang Qixian cited Xunzi: "The ruler of All Under Heaven serves seven generations; the ruler of one state serves five."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ritual Erudite Zhang Qixian cited Xunzi: "The ruler of All Under Heaven serves seven generations; the ruler of one state serves five."

sentences.zh: 則天子七廟，古今達禮。

translations.literal: Thus the emperor has seven temples, a ritual standard accepted across antiquity and the present.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the emperor has seven temples, a ritual standard accepted across antiquity and the present.

sentences.zh: 故《尚書》稱「七代之廟，可以觀德」。

translations.literal: 《Documents》 says, "Through seven generations of temples, one may observe virtue."
translations.idiomatic: 《Documents》 says, "Through seven generations of temples, one may observe virtue."

sentences.zh: 《祭法》稱「王立七廟，一壇一墠」。

translations.literal: 《Sacrificial Regulations》 says, "The king establishes seven temples, one altar, and one open ground."
translations.idiomatic: 《Sacrificial Regulations》 says, "The king establishes seven temples, one altar, and one open ground."

sentences.zh: 《王制》云：「天子七廟，三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七。」

translations.literal: The 《Wang System》 says, "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."
translations.idiomatic: The 《Wang System》 says, "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."

sentences.zh: 莫不尊始封之君，謂之太祖。

translations.literal: All such systems honor the first enfeoffed lord as Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: All such systems honor the first enfeoffed lord as Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太祖之廟，百代不遷。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor's temple remains unmoved for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor's temple remains unmoved for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 袷祭之禮，毀廟之主陳於太祖，未毀廟之主，皆升合食于太祖之室。

translations.literal: At the xia sacrifice, removed temple tablets are arrayed at the Grand Ancestor, while unremoved tablets are raised to share offerings in the Grand Ancestor's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: At the xia sacrifice, removed temple tablets are arrayed at the Grand Ancestor, while unremoved tablets are raised to share offerings in the Grand Ancestor's chamber.

sentences.zh: 太祖東向，昭南向，穆北向。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor faces east; zhao face south, and mu face north.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor faces east; zhao face south, and mu face north.

sentences.zh: 太祖者，商之玄王、周之后稷是也。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestors are exemplified by Xuan Wang of Shang and Hou Ji of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestors are exemplified by Xuan Wang of Shang and Hou Ji of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 太祖之外，更無始祖。

translations.literal: Beyond the Grand Ancestor there is no additional founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Grand Ancestor there is no additional founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 但商自玄王以後，十有四代，至湯而有天下。

translations.literal: From Shang's Xuan Wang to Tang's possession of the realm lay fourteen generations.
translations.idiomatic: From Shang's Xuan Wang to Tang's possession of the realm lay fourteen generations.

sentences.zh: 周自后稷已後，十有七代，至武王而有天下。

translations.literal: From Zhou's Hou Ji to King Wu's possession of the realm lay seventeen generations.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhou's Hou Ji to King Wu's possession of the realm lay seventeen generations.

sentences.zh: 其間代數既遠，遷廟親廟，皆出太祖之後，故得合食有序，尊卑不差。

translations.literal: Since those lines were remote, both removed temples and kin temples stood after the Grand Ancestor, so joint offerings had proper order and rank was not confused.
translations.idiomatic: Since those lines were remote, both removed temples and kin temples stood after the Grand Ancestor, so joint offerings had proper order and rank was not confused.

sentences.zh: 其後漢高祖受命，無始封祖，即以高皇帝為太祖。

translations.literal: When Han Gaozu received the mandate without a first-enfeoffed ancestor, he himself became Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Gaozu received the mandate without a first-enfeoffed ancestor, he himself became Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太上皇高帝之父，立廟享祀，不在昭穆合食之列，為尊于太祖故也。

translations.literal: Gaozu's father, the Grand Supreme Emperor, received a temple and sacrifices but was not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings, because he was honored above the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu's father, the Grand Supreme Emperor, received a temple and sacrifices but was not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings, because he was honored above the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 魏武創業，文帝受命，亦即以武帝為太祖。

translations.literal: Cao Cao founded Wei's enterprise, so when Emperor Wen received the mandate, Emperor Wu likewise became Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Cao founded Wei's enterprise, so when Emperor Wen received the mandate, Emperor Wu likewise became Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 其高皇、太皇、外處君等並為屬尊，不在昭穆合食之列。

translations.literal: Gao Huang, Tai Huang, Waichu Jun, and the others were honored as kin and not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huang, Tai Huang, Waichu Jun, and the others were honored as kin and not included in the zhao-mu shared offerings.

sentences.zh: 晉宣創業，武帝受命，亦即以宣帝為太祖。

translations.literal: Sima Yi founded Jin's enterprise, so when Emperor Wu received the mandate, Emperor Xuan likewise became Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Yi founded Jin's enterprise, so when Emperor Wu received the mandate, Emperor Xuan likewise became Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 其征西、豫章、潁川、京兆府君等並為屬尊，不在昭穆合食之列。

translations.literal: The Zhengxi, Yuzhang, Yingchuan, Jingzhao, and other lords were honored as kin and excluded from the zhao-mu shared offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhengxi, Yuzhang, Yingchuan, Jingzhao, and other lords were honored as kin and excluded from the zhao-mu shared offerings.

sentences.zh: 歷茲已降，至於有隋，宗廟之制，斯禮不改。

translations.literal: From those dynasties through Sui, the ancestral-temple rule remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: From those dynasties through Sui, the ancestral-temple rule remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 故宇文氏以文皇帝為太祖，隋室以武元皇帝為太祖。

translations.literal: Thus Northern Zhou treated Emperor Wen as Grand Ancestor, and Sui treated Emperor Wuyuan as Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Northern Zhou treated Emperor Wen as Grand Ancestor, and Sui treated Emperor Wuyuan as Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 國家誕受在命，累葉重光。

translations.literal: Our dynasty received the mandate, and successive generations have renewed its brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty received the mandate, and successive generations have renewed its brilliance.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝始封唐公，實為太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing, first enfeoffed as Duke of Tang, is truly the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, first enfeoffed as Duke of Tang, is truly the Grand Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 中間代數既近，列在三昭三穆之內，故皇家太廟，唯有六室。

translations.literal: Because the line is still close and Emperor Jing falls within the three zhao and three mu, the Tang Grand Temple has only six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Because the line is still close and Emperor Jing falls within the three zhao and three mu, the Tang Grand Temple has only six chambers.

sentences.zh: 其弘農府君、宣、光二帝，尊于太祖，親盡則遷，不在昭穆合食之數。

translations.literal: The Hongnong Lord, Emperor Xuan, and Emperor Guang stand in honor above the Grand Ancestor; once kinship is exhausted they are moved and are not part of the zhao-mu shared offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongnong Lord, Emperor Xuan, and Emperor Guang stand in honor above the Grand Ancestor; once kinship is exhausted they are moved and are not part of the zhao-mu shared offerings.

sentences.zh: 今皇極再造，孝思匪寧。

translations.literal: Now the imperial order has been restored, and filial concern remains unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial order has been restored, and filial concern remains unsettled.

sentences.zh: 奉二月二十九日敕：「七室已下，依舊號尊崇。」

translations.literal: The edict of the twenty-ninth day of the second month said, "For the seven chambers and below, keep the old titles and honors."
translations.idiomatic: The edict of the twenty-ninth day of the second month said, "For the seven chambers and below, keep the old titles and honors."

sentences.zh: 又奉三月一日敕：「既立七廟，須尊崇始祖，速令詳之」者。

translations.literal: The edict of the first day of the third month added, "Since seven temples are being established, the founding ancestor must be honored. Examine this quickly."
translations.idiomatic: The edict of the first day of the third month added, "Since seven temples are being established, the founding ancestor must be honored. Examine this quickly."

sentences.zh: 伏尋禮經，始祖即是太祖，太祖之外，更無始祖。

translations.literal: Looking through the ritual classics, I find that the founding ancestor is the Grand Ancestor, and outside the Grand Ancestor there is no separate founder.
translations.idiomatic: Looking through the ritual classics, I find that the founding ancestor is the Grand Ancestor, and outside the Grand Ancestor there is no separate founder.

sentences.zh: 周朝太祖之外，以周文王為始祖，不合禮經。

translations.literal: For Zhou to set King Wen as a founding ancestor beyond the Grand Ancestor does not fit the ritual classics.
translations.idiomatic: For Zhou to set King Wen as a founding ancestor beyond the Grand Ancestor does not fit the ritual classics.

sentences.zh: 或有引《白虎通義》云「后稷為始祖、文王為太祖、武王為太宗」，及鄭玄注《詩·雍》序云「太祖謂文王」以為說者。

translations.literal: Some explain this by citing 《Baihu tongyi》, "Hou Ji was founding ancestor, King Wen Grand Ancestor, and King Wu Grand Zong," and Zheng Xuan's note to the 《Shi: Yong》 preface, "Grand Ancestor means King Wen."
translations.idiomatic: Some explain this by citing 《Baihu tongyi》, "Hou Ji was founding ancestor, King Wen Grand Ancestor, and King Wu Grand Zong," and Zheng Xuan's note to the 《Shi: Yong》 preface, "Grand Ancestor means King Wen."

sentences.zh: 其義不然。

translations.literal: That interpretation is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: That interpretation is wrong.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 彼以禮「王者祖有功，宗有德，周人祖文王而宗武王」，故謂文王為太祖耳，非袷祭群主合食之太祖。

translations.literal: They call King Wen Grand Ancestor because ritual says, "Rulers make ancestors of those with merit and zong of those with virtue; Zhou made King Wen ancestor and King Wu zong." But this is not the Grand Ancestor who receives all rulers in shared xia offerings.
translations.idiomatic: They call King Wen Grand Ancestor because ritual says, "Rulers make ancestors of those with merit and zong of those with virtue; Zhou made King Wen ancestor and King Wu zong." But this is not the Grand Ancestor who receives all rulers in shared xia offerings.

sentences.zh: 今之議者，或有欲立涼武昭王為始祖者，殊為不可。

translations.literal: Some now wish to make Liang Wuzhao Wang the founding ancestor, but this is especially wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Some now wish to make Liang Wuzhao Wang the founding ancestor, but this is especially wrong.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 昔在商、周，契、稷始封，湯、武之興，祚由契、稷，故以契、稷為太祖，即皇家之景帝是也。

translations.literal: In Shang and Zhou, Xie and Hou Ji were the first enfeoffed ancestors. Tang and Wu rose from their fortune, so Xie and Hou Ji became Grand Ancestors. For our imperial house, that role belongs to Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In Shang and Zhou, Xie and Hou Ji were the first enfeoffed ancestors. Tang and Wu rose from their fortune, so Xie and Hou Ji became Grand Ancestors. For our imperial house, that role belongs to Emperor Jing.

sentences.zh: 涼武昭王勳業未廣，後主失國，土宇不傳。

translations.literal: Liang Wuzhao Wang's merit was limited, his successor lost the state, and the territory did not continue.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Wuzhao Wang's merit was limited, his successor lost the state, and the territory did not continue.

sentences.zh: 景皇始封，實基明命。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing's first enfeoffment truly founded the Tang mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing's first enfeoffment truly founded the Tang mandate.

sentences.zh: 今乃舍封唐之盛烈，崇西涼之遠構，考之前古，實乖典禮。

translations.literal: To abandon the great enfeoffment in Tang and exalt distant Western Liang violates ancient ritual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: To abandon the great enfeoffment in Tang and exalt distant Western Liang violates ancient ritual precedent.

sentences.zh: 魏氏不以曹參為太祖，晉氏不以殷王仰為太祖，宋氏不以楚元王為太祖，齊、梁不以蕭何為太祖，陳、隋不以胡公、楊震為太祖，則皇家安可以涼武昭王為太祖乎？

translations.literal: Wei did not ancestralize Cao Shen, Jin did not ancestralize the King of Yin, Song did not ancestralize King Yuan of Chu, Qi and Liang did not ancestralize Xiao He, and Chen and Sui did not ancestralize Duke Hu or Yang Zhen. How could Tang make Liang Wuzhao Wang Grand Ancestor?
translations.idiomatic: Wei did not ancestralize Cao Shen, Jin did not ancestralize the King of Yin, Song did not ancestralize King Yuan of Chu, Qi and Liang did not ancestralize Xiao He, and Chen and Sui did not ancestralize Duke Hu or Yang Zhen. How could Tang make Liang Wuzhao Wang Grand Ancestor?

sentences.zh: 漢之東京，大議郊祀，多以周郊后稷，漢當郊堯。

translations.literal: In Eastern Han, a major debate over suburban sacrifice held that because Zhou offered to Hou Ji, Han should offer to Yao.
translations.idiomatic: In Eastern Han, a major debate over suburban sacrifice held that because Zhou offered to Hou Ji, Han should offer to Yao.

sentences.zh: 制上公卿議，議者多同，帝亦然之。

translations.literal: The court sent the issue to the ministers; most agreed, and the emperor was inclined to agree as well.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent the issue to the ministers; most agreed, and the emperor was inclined to agree as well.

sentences.zh: 杜林正議，獨以為「周室之興，祚由后稷。

translations.literal: Only Du Lin argued correctly: "The rise of Zhou came through Hou Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Only Du Lin argued correctly: "The rise of Zhou came through Hou Ji.

sentences.zh: 漢業特起，功不緣堯。

translations.literal: Han arose on its own; its merit did not derive from Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Han arose on its own; its merit did not derive from Yao.

sentences.zh: 祖宗故事，所宜因循。」

translations.literal: The old precedents for ancestors and zong should be followed."
translations.idiomatic: The old precedents for ancestors and zong should be followed."

sentences.zh: 竟從林議。

translations.literal: The court ultimately followed Du Lin.
translations.idiomatic: The court ultimately followed Du Lin.

sentences.zh: 又傳稱，「欲知天上，事問長人」，以其近之。

translations.literal: Another tradition says, "To know Heaven, ask the elders," because they stand closer to it.
translations.idiomatic: Another tradition says, "To know Heaven, ask the elders," because they stand closer to it.

sentences.zh: 武德、貞觀之時，主聖臣賢，其去涼武昭王蓋亦近於今矣。

translations.literal: The Wude and Zhenguan rulers were sagely and their ministers worthy, and they were closer to Liang Wuzhao Wang's time than we are.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude and Zhenguan rulers were sagely and their ministers worthy, and they were closer to Liang Wuzhao Wang's time than we are.

sentences.zh: 當時不立者，必不可立故也。

translations.literal: If they did not establish him then, he surely should not be established now.
translations.idiomatic: If they did not establish him then, he surely should not be established now.

sentences.zh: 今既年代浸遠，方復立之，是非三祖二宗之意。

translations.literal: To establish him only after so many years would violate the intent behind the three ancestors and two zong.
translations.idiomatic: To establish him only after so many years would violate the intent behind the three ancestors and two zong.

sentences.zh: 實恐景皇失職而震怒，武昭虛位而不答，非社稷之福也。

translations.literal: I fear Emperor Jing would be displaced and angered, while Wuzhao would hold an empty position and give no response; this would not benefit the state.
translations.idiomatic: I fear Emperor Jing would be displaced and angered, while Wuzhao would hold an empty position and give no response; this would not benefit the state.

sentences.zh: 宗廟事重，禘祫禮崇，先王以之觀德。

translations.literal: Temple affairs are weighty, and the di and xia rites are exalted; through them the former kings observed virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Temple affairs are weighty, and the di and xia rites are exalted; through them the former kings observed virtue.

sentences.zh: 或者不知其說，既灌而往，孔子不欲觀之。

translations.literal: Some fail to understand this. Confucius himself did not wish to watch after the libation had passed.
translations.idiomatic: Some fail to understand this. Confucius himself did not wish to watch after the libation had passed.

sentences.zh: 今朝命惟新，宜應慎禮，祭如神在，理不可誣。

translations.literal: Now that the dynasty's mandate has been renewed, ritual must be handled carefully. Sacrifice is performed as if the spirits were present; it cannot be falsified.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the dynasty's mandate has been renewed, ritual must be handled carefully. Sacrifice is performed as if the spirits were present; it cannot be falsified.

sentences.zh: 請准敕加太廟為七室，享宣皇帝以備七代，其始祖不合別有尊崇。

translations.literal: I request that the Grand Temple be expanded to seven chambers and Emperor Xuan be sacrificed to as the seventh generation; no separate honor should be given to another founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the Grand Temple be expanded to seven chambers and Emperor Xuan be sacrificed to as the seventh generation; no separate honor should be given to another founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 太常博士劉承慶、尹知章又議云：謹按《王制》：「天子七廟，三昭三穆，與太祖之廟而七。」

translations.literal: Grand Ritual Erudites Liu Chengqing and Yin Zhizhang also cited the 《Wang System》: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ritual Erudites Liu Chengqing and Yin Zhizhang also cited the 《Wang System》: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple."

sentences.zh: 此載籍之明文，古今之通制。

translations.literal: This is the clear written rule and the common system of antiquity and later ages.
translations.idiomatic: This is the clear written rule and the common system of antiquity and later ages.

sentences.zh: 皇唐稽考前範，詳采列辟，崇建宗靈，式遵斯典。

translations.literal: Tang examined earlier models, drew carefully on past rulers, built up the ancestral spirits, and followed this canon.
translations.idiomatic: Tang examined earlier models, drew carefully on past rulers, built up the ancestral spirits, and followed this canon.

sentences.zh: 但以開基之主，受命之君，王跡有淺深，太祖有遠近。

translations.literal: Yet founders and mandate-receiving rulers differ: royal traces may be deep or shallow, and Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.
translations.idiomatic: Yet founders and mandate-receiving rulers differ: royal traces may be deep or shallow, and Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.

sentences.zh: 湯、文祚基契、稷，太祖代遠，出乎昭穆之上，故七廟可全。

translations.literal: Tang and King Wen were rooted in Xie and Hou Ji; because those Grand Ancestors were remote and stood above the zhao-mu line, the full seven temples were possible.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and King Wen were rooted in Xie and Hou Ji; because those Grand Ancestors were remote and stood above the zhao-mu line, the full seven temples were possible.

sentences.zh: 若夏繼唐、虞，功非由鯀；

translations.literal: Xia succeeded Tang and Yu, but its merit did not derive from Gun;
translations.idiomatic: Xia succeeded Tang and Yu, but its merit did not derive from Gun;

sentences.zh: 漢除秦、項，力不因堯。

translations.literal: Han destroyed Qin and Xiang, but its power did not come from Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Han destroyed Qin and Xiang, but its power did not come from Yao.

sentences.zh: 及魏、晉經圖，周、隋撥亂，皆勳隆近代，祖業非遠，受命始封之主，不離昭穆之親，故肇立宗祊，罕聞全制。

translations.literal: Wei, Jin, Zhou, and Sui won their achievements in recent generations, not through remote ancestral enterprises; their mandate-receiving founders still lay within the zhao-mu kinship line, so their first temple systems were rarely complete.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Jin, Zhou, and Sui won their achievements in recent generations, not through remote ancestral enterprises; their mandate-receiving founders still lay within the zhao-mu kinship line, so their first temple systems were rarely complete.

sentences.zh: 夫太祖以功建，昭穆以親崇，有功百代而不遷，親盡七葉而當毀。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor rests on merit; zhao and mu rest on kinship. Merit keeps a tablet unmoved for a hundred generations, while exhausted kinship after seven leaves requires removal.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor rests on merit; zhao and mu rest on kinship. Merit keeps a tablet unmoved for a hundred generations, while exhausted kinship after seven leaves requires removal.

sentences.zh: 或以太祖代淺，廟數非備，更于昭穆之上，遠立合遷之君，曲從七廟之文，深乖迭毀之制。

translations.literal: To force the seven-temple wording by adding a remote but movable ruler above the zhao-mu line, merely because the Grand Ancestor is near, would badly violate the rule of successive removal.
translations.idiomatic: To force the seven-temple wording by adding a remote but movable ruler above the zhao-mu line, merely because the Grand Ancestor is near, would badly violate the rule of successive removal.

sentences.zh: 皇家千齡啟旦，百葉重光。

translations.literal: The imperial house opened a thousand-year dawn and renewed the brightness of a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial house opened a thousand-year dawn and renewed the brightness of a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝浚德基唐，代數猶近，號雖崇于太祖，親尚列于昭穆，且臨六室之位，未申七代之尊。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing founded Tang in deep virtue, but his generation is still near. Though honored as Grand Ancestor, by kinship he remains within the zhao-mu line and one of the six chambers, not yet creating the honor of seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing founded Tang in deep virtue, but his generation is still near. Though honored as Grand Ancestor, by kinship he remains within the zhao-mu line and one of the six chambers, not yet creating the honor of seven generations.

sentences.zh: 是知太廟當六，未合有七。

translations.literal: Thus the Grand Temple should have six chambers and not yet seven.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Grand Temple should have six chambers and not yet seven.

sentences.zh: 故先朝惟有宣、光、景、元、神、堯、文武六代親廟。

translations.literal: The former court therefore had only six generations of kin temples: Xuan, Guang, Jing, Yuan, Shenyao, and Wenwu.
translations.idiomatic: The former court therefore had only six generations of kin temples: Xuan, Guang, Jing, Yuan, Shenyao, and Wenwu.

sentences.zh: 大帝登遐，神主升祔於廟室，以宣皇帝代數當滿，准禮復遷。

translations.literal: When the Great Emperor died and his tablet was enshrined, Emperor Xuan's generations were complete, so ritual moved him out again.
translations.idiomatic: When the Great Emperor died and his tablet was enshrined, Emperor Xuan's generations were complete, so ritual moved him out again.

sentences.zh: 今止有光皇帝已下六代親廟，非是天子之廟數不當有七，要由太祖有遠近之異，故初建有多少之殊。

translations.literal: Now there are only six generations of kin temples from Emperor Guang down. This does not mean the emperor should not have seven temples; it means the number at establishment varies because Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.
translations.idiomatic: Now there are only six generations of kin temples from Emperor Guang down. This does not mean the emperor should not have seven temples; it means the number at establishment varies because Grand Ancestors may be remote or near.

sentences.zh: 敬惟三后臨朝，代多儒雅，神祊事重，禮豈虛存，規模可沿，理難變革。

translations.literal: The three former reigns had many learned classicists, and temple affairs were weighty. Their ritual model was not empty; it can be followed, and principle does not favor changing it.
translations.idiomatic: The three former reigns had many learned classicists, and temple affairs were weighty. Their ritual model was not empty; it can be followed, and principle does not favor changing it.

sentences.zh: 宣皇既非始祖，又廟無祖宗之號，親盡既遷，其在不合重立。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan is not the founder, and his temple has no zu or zong title. Since his kinship line was exhausted and he was moved, he should not be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan is not the founder, and his temple has no zu or zong title. Since his kinship line was exhausted and he was moved, he should not be restored.

sentences.zh: 若禮終運往，建議復崇，實違《王制》之文，不合先朝之旨。

translations.literal: To exalt him again after the ritual order has moved on would violate the 《Wang System》 and the former court's intent.
translations.idiomatic: To exalt him again after the ritual order has moved on would violate the 《Wang System》 and the former court's intent.

sentences.zh: 請依貞觀之故事，無改三聖之宏規，光崇六室，不虧古議。

translations.literal: We request following Zhenguan precedent, preserving the grand rule of the Three Sages, and honoring the six chambers without impairing the ancient judgment.
translations.idiomatic: We request following Zhenguan precedent, preserving the grand rule of the Three Sages, and honoring the six chambers without impairing the ancient judgment.

sentences.zh: 時有制令宰相更加詳定，禮部尚書祝欽明等奏言：「博士三人，自分兩議：張齊賢以始同太祖，不合更祖昭王；

translations.literal: Then there was an edict ordering the chief ministers to deliberate further; Minister of Rites Zhu Qinming and others memorialized, saying: "Three erudites divided into two opinions: Zhang Qixian held that from the first they were the same as the Great Founder, and it was not fitting to further take King Zhao as ancestor;
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent chancellors to refine the question; Zhu Qinming of Rites reported: "Three erudites split two ways—Zhang Qixian said they were already Great Founder and King Zhao should not be added as ancestor;

sentences.zh: 劉承慶以《王制》三昭三穆，不合重崇宣帝。

translations.literal: Liu Chengqing held that the three zhao and three mu of the 《Wang System》 did not permit doubly honoring Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chengqing cited the 《Wang System》's three zhao and three mu: no double honor for Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 臣等商量，請依張齊賢以景皇帝為太祖，依劉承慶尊崇六室。」

translations.literal: Your subjects deliberated and request: follow Zhang Qixian in taking Emperor Jing as Great Founder, follow Liu Chengqing in honoring with six chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects deliberated and request: follow Zhang Qixian in taking Emperor Jing as Great Founder, follow Liu Chengqing in honoring with six chambers."

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: The decree followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 尋有制以孝敬皇帝為義宗，升祔於太廟。

translations.literal: Soon there was an edict making Filial and Respectful Emperor the Righteous Ancestor, elevated enshrinement in the Great Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict made the Filial and Respectful Emperor the Righteous Ancestor and elevated him into the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 其年八月，崇祔光皇帝、太祖景皇帝、代祖元皇帝、高祖神堯皇帝、太宗文武聖皇帝、皇考高宗天皇大帝、皇兄義宗孝敬皇帝于東都之太廟，躬行享獻之禮。

translations.literal: That year eighth month: elevated enshrinement of Emperors Guang, Jing as Great Founder, Yuan as Dynastic Ancestor, Gaozu as Emperor Shenyao, Taizong as the Civil and Martial Sage Emperor, father Emperor Gaozong the Great Heavenly Emperor, elder brother Righteous Ancestor Filial and Respectful Emperor at the eastern capital Great Temple; the emperor in person performed the offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: That eighth month at the eastern Great Temple: elevated enshrinement for Guang, Jing as Great Founder, Yuan as dynastic ancestor, Shenyao Gaozu, sage Taizong, heavenly Gaozong, and Righteous Ancestor Filial and Respectful—the emperor offered in person.

sentences.zh: 二年，駕還京師，太廟自是亦崇享七室，仍改武氏崇尊廟為崇恩廟。

translations.literal: Year 2: when the carriage returned to the capital, the Great Temple from then also honored seven chambers; still changed Wu clan Chongzun Temple to Chong'en Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Year 2: back in the capital, the Great Temple too kept seven chambers; Wu Chongzun became Chong'en Temple.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，復令崇恩廟一依天授時享祭。

translations.literal: Second month next year: again ordered Chong'en Temple to follow Tian'shou-era offerings entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's second month: Chong'en was again ordered to follow Tian'shou offerings.

sentences.zh: 時武三思用事，密令安樂公主諷中宗，故有此制。

translations.literal: At the time Wu Sansi was in power; secretly ordered Princess Anle to persuade Zhongzong—hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sansi then held sway; Princess Anle quietly swayed Zhongzong—hence the edict.

sentences.zh: 尋又特令武氏崇恩廟齋郎取五品子充。

translations.literal: Soon also specially ordered Wu clan Chong'en Temple Fast Youths to be filled with sons of fifth-rank officials.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wu's Chong'en Fast Youths were specially filled with fifth-rank sons.

sentences.zh: 太常博士楊孚奏言：「太廟齋郎，承前只七品已下子。

translations.literal: Erudite Yang Fu memorialized, saying: "Great Temple Fast Youths—formerly only sons of seventh rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fu wrote: "Great Temple Fast Youths were formerly sons of seventh rank and below.

sentences.zh: 今崇恩廟齋郎既取五品子，即太廟齋郎作何等級？」

translations.literal: Now that Chong'en Temple Fast Youths take fifth-rank sons, what rank should Great Temple Fast Youths be?
translations.idiomatic: Now that Chong'en Temple Fast Youths take fifth-rank sons, what rank should Great Temple Fast Youths be?"

sentences.zh: 上曰：「太廟齋郎亦准崇恩廟置。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Great Temple Fast Youths likewise follow Chong'en Temple."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Match the Great Temple to Chong'en."

sentences.zh: 孚奏曰：「崇恩廟為太廟之臣，太廟為崇恩廟之君，以臣准君，猶為僭逆，以君准臣，天下疑懼。

translations.literal: Fu memorialized, saying: "Chong'en Temple is subject of the Great Temple, the Great Temple is lord of Chong'en Temple—to equalize subject with lord is still usurpation; to equalize lord with subject makes the realm doubtful and afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Fu replied: "Chong'en is the Great Temple's subject, the Great Temple its lord—equating subject to lord is usurpation; equating lord to subject breeds fear.

sentences.zh: 孔子曰：『名不正則言不順，言不順則事不成，事不成則禮樂不興，禮樂不興則刑罰不中，刑罰不中則人無所措手足。

translations.literal: Confucius said: 'If names are not correct speech is not in accord; if speech is not in accord affairs do not succeed; if affairs do not succeed rites and music do not flourish; if rites and music do not flourish punishments miss the mark; if punishments miss the mark the people have nowhere to place hand or foot.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius said: 'Wrong names unbalance speech; unbalanced speech fails affairs; failed affairs stall rites and music; stalled rites skew punishments; skewed punishments leave the people without footing.

sentences.zh: 故君子名之必可言也。』

translations.literal: Therefore the noble man in naming must make speakable words.
translations.idiomatic: So the noble man's names must be sayable.

sentences.zh: 伏願無惑邪言，以為亂始。」

translations.literal: Your subject wishes no confusion from heterodox words as the beginning of disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject wishes no confusion from heterodox words as the beginning of disorder."

sentences.zh: 其事乃寢。

translations.literal: The matter then lapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The plan died.

sentences.zh: 崇恩廟至睿宗踐祚，乃廢毀之。

translations.literal: Chong'en Temple—when Ruizong took the throne, was then abolished and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Chong'en lasted until Ruizong's accession, then was abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬，將葬中宗孝和皇帝于定陵，中書令姚元之、吏部尚書宋璟奏言：「准禮，大行皇帝山陵事終，即合祔廟。

translations.literal: Winter: about to bury Emperor Xiaohui of Zhongzong at Ding Mausoleum; Chief Minister Yao Yuanzhi and Minister of Personnel Song Jing memorialized, saying: "Per ritual, when the great imperial tomb matters end, enshrinement should follow at once.
translations.idiomatic: Winter: Zhongzong Xiaohui was to be buried at Ding; Yao Yuanzhi and Song Jing wrote: "When the great tomb rites end, enshrinement should follow immediately.

sentences.zh: 其太廟第七室，先祔皇兄義宗孝敬皇帝、哀皇后裴氏神主。

translations.literal: The seventh chamber of the Great Temple had already enshrined the elder brother Righteous Ancestor Filial and Respectful Emperor and the Lamenting Empress Pei.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh chamber already held Righteous Ancestor Filial and Respectful and Lamenting Empress Pei.

sentences.zh: 伏以義宗未登大位，崩後追尊，神龍之初，乃特令遷祔。

translations.literal: Your subject observes: Righteous Ancestor never ascended the great throne; posthumously honored after death—in the early Shenlong era a special order moved enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous Ancestor never reigned; he was honored after death and specially moved in early Shenlong.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》之義，國君即位未逾年者，不合列敘昭穆。

translations.literal: The principle of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 is that a ruler of a state who has not yet been enthroned for a full year is not fit to be ranked in the zhao and mu sequence.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 rule is that a ruler enthroned less than a year is not ranked in zhao and mu.

sentences.zh: 又古者祖宗各別立廟，孝敬皇帝恭陵既在洛州，望於東都別立義宗之廟，遷祔孝敬皇帝、哀皇后神主，命有司以時享祭，則不違先旨，又協古訓，人神允穆，進退得宜。

translations.literal: Also in antiquity ancestor-for-father each had separate temples. Filial and Respectful Emperor's Gong Mausoleum is already in Luozhou—your subject requests a separate Righteous Ancestor temple at the eastern capital, moving enshrinement of Filial and Respectful Emperor and Lamenting Empress spirit tablets, ordering the relevant office seasonal offerings—then not violating the prior intent, also harmonizing with ancient instruction; human and spirit both agree; advance and retreat all fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Antiquity gave each forebear a separate temple. Filial and Respectful lies at Gong in Luozhou—build a Righteous Ancestor temple in the east, move both tablets, and offer by season: prior intent kept, ancient rule met, spirits and men aligned.

sentences.zh: 在此神主，望入夾室安置。

translations.literal: These spirit tablets—your subject requests placement in side chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Place these tablets in the side chambers.

sentences.zh: 伏願陛下以禮斷恩。」

translations.literal: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to cut favor with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to cut favor with ritual."

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: The decree followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 及既葬，祔中宗孝和皇帝、和思皇后趙氏神主於太廟。

translations.literal: When burial was done, enshrined spirit tablets of Emperor Xiaohui Zhongzong and Empress Zhaosi Zhao in the Great Temple.
translations.idiomatic: After burial, Zhongzong Xiaohui and Empress Zhaosi Zhao were enshrined in the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 其義宗即於東都從善裏建廟享祀。

translations.literal: Righteous Ancestor was then at eastern capital Congshan Lane with temple established for offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous Ancestor was served at a new temple in Congshan Lane, eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 時又追尊昭成、肅明二皇后，于親仁裏別置儀坤廟，四時享祭，

translations.literal: At the time also posthumously honored Empresses Zhaocheng and Suming; at Qinren Lane a separate Yikun Temple was set up with four-season offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Empresses Zhaocheng and Suming were also posthumously honored; Yikun Temple at Qinren Lane received seasonal rites.

sentences.zh: 開元四年，睿宗崩，及行祔廟之禮，太常博士陳貞節、蘇獻等奏議曰：「謹按孝和皇帝在廟，七室已滿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kaiyuan, Ruizong died. When the rite of enshrining him in the temple was to be performed, Erudites of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Chen Zhenjie, Su Xian, and others memorialized: "We respectfully note that Emperor Xiaohe is in the temple and the seven chambers are already full.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 4: after Ruizong died, Chen Zhenjie and Su Xian argued over his enshrinement: "Xiaohe is already in the temple, and the seven chambers are full.

sentences.zh: 今睿宗大聖真皇帝是孝和之弟，甫及仲冬，禮當祔遷。

translations.literal: Now Emperor Ruizong the Great Sagely True Emperor is Xiaohui's younger brother—just reaching mid-winter, ritual requires enshrinement migration.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong the Great Sagely True Emperor is Xiaohui's younger brother—mid-winter demands his enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 但兄弟入廟，古則有焉，遞遷之禮，昭穆須正。

translations.literal: Though brothers entering the temple existed in antiquity, the rite of successive removal—zhao and mu must be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers did enter temples in antiquity, but succession rules require correct zhao and mu.

sentences.zh: 謹按《禮論》，太常賀循議云：『兄弟不相為後也。

translations.literal: According to the 《Treatises on Ritual》, Imperial Sacrifices Officer He Xun's deliberation says: 'Brothers do not succeed one another as heirs.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Ritual Treatises》 cite He Xun: 'Brothers do not succeed one another.

sentences.zh: 故殷之盤庚，不序于陽甲，而上繼於先君；

translations.literal: Hence Yin Pan Geng is not ranked after Yang Jia but succeeds the former lord above;
translations.idiomatic: Yin's Pan Geng is not listed after Yang Jia but continues the prior lord;

sentences.zh: 漢之光武，不嗣于孝成，而上承於元帝。』

translations.literal: Han Guangwu does not succeed Xiaocheng but receives above from Emperor Yuan.'
translations.idiomatic: Han's Guangwu does not follow Xiaocheng but inherits from Emperor Yuan.

sentences.zh: 又曰：『晉惠帝無後，懷帝承統，懷帝自繼于世祖，而不繼于惠帝。

translations.literal: Also: 'Jin Emperor Hui had no heir; Emperor Huai received the succession; Huai succeeded himself from Shizu, not from Emperor Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Hui had no heir; Huai took the line from Shizu, not from Hui.

sentences.zh: 其惠帝當同陽甲、孝成，別出為廟。』

translations.literal: Emperor Hui should be the same as Yang Jia and Xiaocheng, separately enshrined outside.'
translations.idiomatic: Hui should join Yang Jia and Xiaocheng in a separate shrine.

sentences.zh: 又曰：『若兄弟相代，則共是一代，昭穆位同。

translations.literal: Also: 'If brothers replace one another, they share one generation; zhao and mu positions identical.
translations.idiomatic: If brothers alternate, they share one generation and one zhao-mu slot.

sentences.zh: 至其當遷，不可兼毀二廟。』

translations.literal: When they should be removed, two temples cannot both be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: When rotation comes, two temples cannot both be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 此蓋禮之常例也。

translations.literal: This is the constant example of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That is ritual's standing rule.

sentences.zh: 《荀卿子》曰，『有天下者事七代』，謂從禰已上也。

translations.literal: The 《Xunzi》 says, 'He who has the realm serves seven generations'--meaning from the honored father upward.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Xunzi》 says, 'He who holds the realm serves seven generations'--from honored father up.

sentences.zh: 尊者統廣，故恩及遠祖。

translations.literal: The honored unify broadly, hence grace extends to distant ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: The exalted reach wide, so grace reaches distant forebears.

sentences.zh: 若旁容兄弟，上毀祖考，此則天子有不得全事於七代之義矣。

translations.literal: If brothers are admitted laterally, destroying ancestor-fathers above—then the Son of Heaven has the meaning of being unable fully to serve seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: Admit brothers sideways and remove ancestors above—the Son of Heaven cannot fully keep seven generations.

sentences.zh: 孝和皇帝有中興之功，而無後嗣，請同殷之陽甲、漢之成帝，出為別廟，時祭不虧，大祫之辰，合食太祖。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaohui had merit of restoring the dynasty but no posterity—your subject requests the same as Yin Yang Jia, Han Emperor Cheng: separate temple outside, seasonal rites not diminished; at great he sacrifice, joint feast at Great Founder.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaohui restored the dynasty but left no heir—treat him like Yang Jia and Cheng: separate temple, unbroken seasonal rites, joint feast at the Great Founder on great he days.

sentences.zh: 奉睿宗神主升祔太廟，上繼高宗，則昭穆永貞，獻祼長序。」

translations.literal: Receive Emperor Ruizong's spirit tablet, elevated enshrinement in Great Temple, succeeding above Emperor Gaozong—then zhao and mu forever stable, libation and blessing long in order.
translations.idiomatic: Receive Emperor Ruizong's spirit tablet, elevated enshrinement in Great Temple, succeeding above Emperor Gaozong—then zhao and mu forever stable, libation and blessing long in order."

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: The decree followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 初令以儀坤廟為中宗廟，尋又改造中宗廟於太廟之西。

translations.literal: Initially ordered Yikun Temple to become Zhongzong's temple; soon again reformed Zhongzong Temple west of the Great Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Yikun was first made Zhongzong's temple, then Zhongzong's shrine was rebuilt west of the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 貞節等又以肅明皇后不合與昭成皇后配祔睿宗，奏議曰：「禮，宗廟父昭子穆，皆有配座，每室一帝一后，禮之正儀。

translations.literal: Zhenjie and others also held that Empress Suming was not fit to be paired with Empress Zhaocheng in enshrinement with Ruizong; deliberated, saying: "Ritual: ancestral temples father-zhao son-mu—each has a consort seat; each chamber one emperor one empress—the orthodox ritual form.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjie et al. also argued Suming should not pair with Zhaocheng at Ruizong's shrine: "Rite sets father-zhao, son-mu, one consort per chamber—one emperor, one empress: the orthodox form.

sentences.zh: 自夏、殷而來，無易茲典。

translations.literal: From Xia and Yin down, this statute has not been changed.
translations.idiomatic: Since Xia and Yin, this institution has never been altered.

sentences.zh: 伏惟昭成皇后，有太姒之德，已配食于睿宗；

translations.literal: We humbly note: Empress Zhaocheng had the virtue of Tai Si and already shares sacrifice in Ruizong's chamber;
translations.idiomatic: It is submitted that Empress Zhaocheng possessed Tai Si's virtue and already shares sacrifice with Ruizong;

sentences.zh: 則肅明皇后無啟母之尊，自應別立一廟。

translations.literal: then Empress Suming lacked the standing of Qi's mother and ought on her own to have a separate temple established.
translations.idiomatic: whereas Empress Suming did not have Qi's mother's rank and should have a temple of her own.

sentences.zh: 謹按《周禮》云『奏夷則，歌小呂，以享先妣』者，姜嫄是也。

translations.literal: We respectfully cite the 《Zhou Rites》: "Play Yi ze, sing Xiao lu, to offer to the former consort"--that is Jiang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Zhou Rites》 state that playing Yi ze and singing Xiao lu to honor a former consort refers to Jiang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 姜嫄是帝嚳之妃，后稷之母，特為立廟，名曰閟宮。

translations.literal: Jiang Yuan was consort of Emperor Ku and mother of Hou Ji; a temple was specially established for her, named Bi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yuan was Emperor Ku's consort and Hou Ji's mother; she was given a separate temple called Bi Palace.

sentences.zh: 又《禮論》云，晉伏系之議云：『晉簡文鄭宣后既不配食，乃築宮於外，歲時就廟享祭而已。』

translations.literal: Also the 《Ritual Disquisitions》 says Fu Xi's discussion of Jin states: "Empress Xuande of Jin Emperor Jianwen, since she was not allotted shared sacrifice, built a palace outside; at the seasons one went to the temple to offer sacrifice only."
translations.idiomatic: The 《Ritual Disquisitions》 also cite Fu Xi on Jin: when Empress Xuande of Emperor Jianwen was denied shared sacrifice, a palace was built outside and seasonal offerings were made there alone.

sentences.zh: 今肅明皇后無祔配之位，請同姜嫄、宣后，別廟而處，四時享祭如舊儀。」

translations.literal: Now Empress Suming has no position for complementary enshrinement; we ask, following Jiang Yuan and Empress Xuande, to have a separate temple and placement, the four seasons' sacrifices as the old observances.
translations.idiomatic: Now Empress Suming has no position for complementary enshrinement; we ask, following Jiang Yuan and Empress Xuande, to have a separate temple and placement, the four seasons' sacrifices as the old observances."

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: The decree followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 於是遷昭成皇后神主祔于睿宗之室，惟留肅明神主於儀坤廟。

translations.literal: Thereupon the tablet of Empress Zhaocheng was moved to share sacrifice in Ruizong's chamber; only the tablet of Suming was left in Yikun Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The tablet of Empress Zhaocheng was then moved to Ruizong's chamber, leaving only Suming's tablet in Yikun Temple.

sentences.zh: 時太常卿姜皎復與禮官上表曰：「臣聞敬宗尊祖，享德崇恩，必也正名，用光時憲，禮也。

translations.literal: At that time Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Jiang Jiao again, with ritual officials, submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant has heard that revering the clan and honoring ancestors, enjoying virtue and exalting grace, must rectify names to illuminate the statutes of the age—this is ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Director Jiang Jiao and the ritual officials again memorialized: "We hear that revering ancestors and exalting grace require correct titles to honor the age's laws—that is ritual.

sentences.zh: 伏見太廟中則天皇后配高宗天皇大帝，題云『天后聖帝武氏』。

translations.literal: We note in the Grand Temple Empress Zetian is enshrined with Emperor Gaozong Tianhuang Dadi, the inscription reading "Holy Emperor Wu of the Heavenly Empress."
translations.idiomatic: In the Grand Temple Empress Zetian shares sacrifice with Emperor Gaozong, inscribed as "Holy Emperor Wu of the Heavenly Empress."

sentences.zh: 伏尋昔居寵秩，親承顧托，因攝大政，事乃從權。

translations.literal: We trace how in the past she held favored rank and personally received the entrustment; she then assumed great government, the affair being one of expedient power.
translations.idiomatic: She once held favored rank, received the late emperor's trust, and took power as an expedient measure.

sentences.zh: 神龍之初，已去帝號。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shenlong the imperial title was already removed.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Shenlong her imperial title had already been removed.

sentences.zh: 岑羲等不閑政體，復題帝名。

translations.literal: Cen Xi and others were unversed in the body of government and again inscribed an imperial name.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Xi and others, ignorant of governance, restored an imperial title on the inscription.

sentences.zh: 若又使帝號長存，恐非聖朝通典。

translations.literal: If the imperial title is again made to endure long, I fear it is not the general statute of the sagely court.
translations.idiomatic: To let an imperial title stand again would violate court precedent.

sentences.zh: 夫七廟者，高祖神堯皇帝之廟也。

translations.literal: The seven temples are the temples of the High Ancestor, the Divine Yao Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The seven temples are those of the High Ancestor, Emperor Shen Yao.

sentences.zh: 父昭子穆，祖德宗功，非夫帝子天孫，乘乾出震者，不得升祔於斯矣。

translations.literal: Father zhao, son mu; ancestral virtue and clan achievement—none but sons of emperors and grandsons of Heaven, those who mount Qian and issue from Zhen, may ascend to enshrinement there.
